name: New Orleans Seafood Pepper Pot & Gumbo (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Loaded with Cajun cayenne heat, fibrous diced bell peppers, celery, onions ("holy trinity"), and okra/kale that chemically and mechanically irritate an inflamed gut.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip during flares or cautious days. Ask your server for plain chicken noodle broth or a smooth pureed soup alternative.
watchOuts: Diced bell pepper skins and celery strings
